name: agent-harness-pin-gemini
description: Version oracle for the Gemini CLI. Never installed; Dependabot bumps this manifest to signal upstream releases and CI parity spec keeps Providers::Gemini::SUPPORTED_CLI_VERSION in sync. Provider pins to `= 0.35.3`, so Dependabot is set to ignore this package (see .github/dependabot.yml) until upstream stabilises. See vendor/pins/README.md and issue #336.
